reconnect.title: Reconnect {{name}}?
reconnect.consequence: The interface goes down and up again; connections through it drop meanwhile
reconnect.appConsequence: The app reaches the router through this interface: it will lose the connection for a few seconds
reconnect.pppoe: PPPoE dials again, so your public IP may change

routes.title: Routes
routes.staticHint: Routes you add here go into the router's network configuration and survive reboots.
routes.gatewayHint: Empty: send straight out of the interface

error.target-invalid: Not a network of this address family
error.gateway-invalid: Not an address of this family
error.gateway-outside: The gateway isn't on this interface's network

routes.consequence: A wrong route can cut off devices or this phone; the router undoes the change after 90 seconds if the app loses contact

result.rolledBack: The change was reverted: the router didn't get a confirmation in time

connections.title: Connections
connections.filter: Filter by device, address or port
connections.noAccounting: Byte counts need connection accounting (the RouteLink plugin turns it on).

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.forwardsHint: A port forward makes a device on your network reachable from the internet.
firewall.managedHint: Rules marked App block devices; change them on the device's page.
firewall.advancedHint: This rule has options the app doesn't show ({{options}}); they are kept.
firewall.name: Name

error.port-invalid: A port (1–65535) or a range like 8000-8100
error.range-mismatch: A range must be as long as the external one
error.ip-family: Doesn't match the chosen IP version
error.direction-invalid: A rule needs a zone on at least one side
error.port-needs-tcp-udp: Ports only apply to TCP and UDP

firewall.consequence: The firewall reloads; a wrong rule can block devices or this phone, and the router undoes the change after 90 seconds if the app loses contact
firewall.exposeConsequence: The device becomes reachable from the internet on this port

edit.otherProto: This interface uses {{proto}}, which the app can't edit. Choosing a type below replaces it.
edit.dnsHint: Empty: use the provider's. Separate several with spaces or commas.
edit.dhcpHint: Hands out addresses to devices on the LAN.
edit.startHint: Offset from the network address, e.g. 100 → .100

error.gateway-outside: The gateway must be in the same network
error.dns-invalid: Not a list of IP addresses
error.pool-outside: The pool runs past the end of the network

edit.wanConsequence: The internet connection restarts; if the app loses contact, the router undoes the change after 90 seconds
edit.dhcpConsequence: Devices get addresses from the new pool when they renew

moveConsequences.reconnect: Devices, this phone included, need to reconnect (Wi-Fi off and on) to get an address in the new network
moveConsequences.static: Devices with a fixed address or gateway (an access point, for example) must be changed by hand
moveConsequences.leases: These reserved addresses fall outside the new network: {{list}}
moveConsequences.undo: If the app can't reach the new address within 2 minutes, the router goes back to the old one

edit.movingHint: Turn this phone's Wi-Fi off and on now (or unplug and replug its cable) so it gets an address in the new network. The app confirms the change as soon as it reaches the router.
